description: Change a reminder. Only the fields you pass change. Get reminderId from list_event_reminders.

eventId.description: The event id (from the matching list tool).

recipientGroupIds.description: Group ids when recipientType is specific_groups.

recipientRoles.description: Role names when recipientType is specific_roles.

recipientUserIds.description: User ids when recipientType is specific_users (see list_tour_members).

reminderId.description: The reminder id (from the matching list tool).

triggerTimeMinutes.description: Minutes before/after the event (0 with type "at").

triggerTimeType.description: When the reminder fires relative to the event.

name: update_event_reminder
title: Update event reminder
